Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome types {#types}

Browse tenant JSON Schema primitive types.

```text
apiome types [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`list`](#types-list), [`publish`](#types-publish), [`search`](#types-search), [`show`](#types-show), [`unpublish`](#types-unpublish).

## apiome types list {#types-list}

List tenant primitives (GET /v1/primitives/{tenant_slug}).

```text
apiome types list [OPTIONS]
```

## apiome types publish {#types-publish}

Publish a tenant-owned type (not exposed on /v1 REST).

```text
apiome types publish [OPTIONS] IDENTIFIER
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | text | yes | Type UUID or slug. |

## apiome types search {#types-search}

Search tenant primitives by substring match on list results.

```text
apiome types search [OPTIONS] QUERY
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `QUERY` | text | yes | Search query (name, slug, or description). |

## apiome types show {#types-show}

Fetch one primitive by UUID or slug.

```text
apiome types show [OPTIONS] IDENTIFIER
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | text | yes | Type UUID or slug. |

## apiome types unpublish {#types-unpublish}

Unpublish a system-wide type (not exposed on /v1 REST).

```text
apiome types unpublish [OPTIONS] IDENTIFIER
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | text | yes | Type UUID or slug. |
